isolated_admission: Native/Python action agreement <1.2e-13; regular and 8% deterministic perturbed free clouds pass rigid/affine/adjoint/linear/angular tests; checkerboard positive. Edge profiles admit mixed Ny>=4 and full-wave vertical Ny>=8. Horizontal L/dx>=16.
geometry: Periodic x/z .2m, bed y=0, box y=.1m, fluid H=.05m. Geometric mass rho*dx^3, pressure h=2dx, self density bias, density-aware fixed bed samples, compression-only constraints, correction=.5, eps=.02/h^2, contact .51dx, centre inset=.5dx.
cases: horizontal natural free surface/slip bed, U=.01 and .1m/s, nu=.001
vertical mixed natural free surface/no-slip bed, U=.01 and .1m/s, nu=.001
stationary hydrostatic g=9.81m/s2, same viscosity and boundary variants
resolution: Ny=4,8,12,16 subject to isolated profile admission; at least three spatial levels if controlled full model remains stable; duration 1 viscous e-fold (1/(nu*(pi/.1)^2)), rounded to complete dt, spatial reference keeps physical geometry. dt=1/480s, pressure24; independent dt1/960 and iterations48. Stop candidate qualification when a physical gate fails, retain failures; investigate finest levels only where interpretable.
viscous_time_integration: Backward Euler of exact adjoint strain operator, conjugate gradients relative residual<=1e-11 (absolute1e-14), max1000. K loss = dt*power(v_new)+.5*mean|v_new-v_old|^2, including discretisation loss separately. Timestep refinement, no viscosity fitting.
additional_criteria: Use protocol amplitude, initial-rms L2, rate, hydrostatic, density, energy, wall traction, spacing gates. Report vertical noise separately; no resetting velocity during measured interval. Initial shear constructed from analytical profile at t=0, hydrostatic conditioning not silently added.
snapshot: Every accepted step ledger and p/v every ~.05s including initial/final. Failed prefixes preserved.
